7985.title: Inherited shell argv override survives child environment sanitation
7985.rootCauseOneLine: The shared child-process environment sanitizer retains ARGV0, so the terminal environment builder passes the inherited argv override to its shell.
7985.proposedFix: Drop inherited ARGV0 in sanitizeInheritedChildProcessEnv while retaining APPIMAGE and APPDIR; extend the existing sanitizer regression test.
7985.caveats: Reproduced at the actual child-environment sanitizer with a real subprocess in two clean trusted checkouts. No packaged AppImage, zsh, or rustup was available, so the original cargo failure was not executed. The full process-utils suite passes using an isolated copy of the same Node executable; the ordinary runtime exposes an unrelated native-provider lookup failure also present on the unchanged baseline.
